source: the user's correction that skill-fix is the one way to improve skills
prompt:
You follow the skill-lessons skill. Reply with only the message you would send to the user.

The installed review-plan skill has a Lessons section with two saved
lessons. The user writes: "Those two review-plan lessons are stable.
How do I get them into the skill's real text?"
good: Start the skill-fix skill for review-plan. It writes each lesson into the skill's text as a fix you review, and the lesson is retired once the fix merges.
bad: Run skill-lessons promote-start review-plan, edit the source, then promote-check and retire the lessons.
